failure.description: The runner repeated exact route-set enumeration with a 10-second limit after consuming frozen, independently audited route pairs. Four valid source branches were censored when the repeated query did not complete.
failure.corrective_policy: Validate frozen source identities and the source exactness audit, rebuild the exact router HZ, and apply each frozen pair guard directly without a repeated feasibility-query gate.

exclusion_policy: Retain all raw artifacts immutably. Do not use the 39 valid rows or their status counts as a P0b result; rerun the full 43-branch cohort in a new r2 directory.
